name: i am feeling things
source:
This tiny bitsy game / visual novel tells the story of Lydia and Ophelia - two lesbians that experience their first date in person, after they have been talking online for a while. The scene takes place in a tiny café, on a rainy day. Both characters are adults and above the age of 21.

[From [url=https://lostlesbian.itch.io/feeling-things]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
这款小巧的Bitsy游戏／视觉小说，讲述莉迪娅与奥菲莉娅的故事。两位女同性恋者在网上聊了一段时间后，终于迎来第一次线下约会。故事发生在雨天的一间小咖啡馆里。两位角色均已成年，且都在21岁以上。

[摘自[url=https://lostlesbian.itch.io/feeling-things]Itch.io[/url]]
